mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical fourteen-period Money Flow Index returning inside its 20/80 envelope on completed four-hour BTC auctions marks quote-notional-weighted typical-price pressure beginning to normalize; follow the re-entry direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when MFI crosses strictly above 20 after being at or below 20; short when it crosses strictly below 80 after being at or above 80
mechanism.why_distinct: RSI uses unweighted close changes, CCI standardizes typical price without participation, and stochastic uses close range location. HVMFI signs typical-price changes then weights them by exact quote asset volume before rolling positive/negative flow aggregation, with no fitted threshold, OI, funding, prior event, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour quote-notional-weighted pressure re-entry clocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T), including summed quote_asset_volume
features.positive_flow: raw flow when typical price exceeds prior typical price, else zero
features.negative_flow: raw flow when typical price is below prior typical price, else zero; ties contribute neither
features.mfi: 100-100/(1+rolling 14 positive-flow sum/rolling 14 negative-flow sum); zero negative maps 100, zero positive maps 0, both zero invalid
features.reentry: current MFI strictly crosses inward through 20 or 80 from immediately prior valid MFI
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical quote-notional-weighted money-flow re-entry under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no MFI period, volume field, formula, level, crossing, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: Gene Quong and Avrum Soudack, canonical Money Flow Index convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: 14 completed periods; typical price=(high+low+close)/3; raw flow=typical price*quote volume; positive/negative by typical-price change; MFI=100-100/(1+positive/negative); conventional 20/80 re-entry
external_basis.selection_use: published period, formula, levels, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
